messages:
maria_support: Heads-up — ACME reported requests routing to EU edge even though they set region=us in query and header. High latency and extra cross-region billing. I have logs and a repro.
acme_john: Confirmed. Started ~2h ago after a deploy. Saw 5-10x latency spikes, and usage billed to eu. Our app sets cookie 'rd_region=us' and header 'X-Client-Region: us'.
maria_support: Thanks @acme_john. Can you paste a curl you used?
acme_john: Sure: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME..." -H "X-Client-Region: us" --cookie "rd_region=us" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?prompt=hi&region=us"
```
acme_john: Router shows route decision: region=eu. Trace ID: trace-0a1b2c3d
sam_sre: Looking. From initial logs I see an incoming header X-Client-Region with empty value for some requests: `X-Client-Region: ""` — likely inserted by a proxy rewrite that ran during today's edge deploy. That will cause our header precedence logic to treat header as present but empty, then fallback to cookie which is set to eu for some sessions.
lee_backend: Wait, cookie is set to eu? ACME says they set rd_region=us. Are there previous cookies or domain collisions?
acme_john: We checked: rd_region=us in our app and client. But the browser also had a legacy cookie from *.redwood.example old domain path set rd_region=eu (from earlier test). Some requests have both cookies; the proxy normalizes cookie order and seems to put the legacy eu cookie first.
maria_support: Action item: reproduce from a clean browser session. Also can we get a raw request capture from edge for trace-0a1b2c3d?@sam_sre
sam_sre: Pasted raw headers for trace: 
```
GET /v1/generate?prompt=hi&region=us HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME...
X-Client-Region: 
Cookie: rd_region=eu; rd_region=us; other=1
```
sam_sre: The proxy earlier today added an empty X-Client-Region header for specific client IPs during a header-normalization patch. Our router code uses the precedence: explicit header (if present and non-empty) > query param > cookie. But current code checks header presence before trimming value, so an empty header counts as present and short-circuits query param logic, then cookie parsing later takes eu due to cookie ordering.
lee_backend: I can reproduce locally by injecting an empty X-Client-Region. Repro steps: 
1) set two cookies `rd_region=eu; rd_region=us` (order matters)
2) send `X-Client-Region:` (empty header)
3) router picks eu.
Expected was that empty header should be treated as absent.
maria_support: Customer impact: increased latency and some requests billed at eu unit rates. ACME wants a mitigation and ETA.
acme_john: We have a spike in 5xxs when downstream model not in EU pool; fallback behavior caused errors too.
sam_sre: Temporary mitigation: edge team can strip X-Client-Region if empty. I can flip a rule to drop empty headers in the next 10m. @proxy-bot can you apply a header strip rule?
proxy-bot: deploy-bot:run: strip-empty-header X-Client-Region -> queued
proxy-bot: Applied header strip rule to edge-pop us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Will take ~60s to propagate.
lee_backend: Meanwhile I'll patch router code to treat empty/nul headers as absent (PR ready, needs review). Code snippet: 
```
region = headers.get('X-Client-Region')
if region is None or region.strip() == '':
    # treat as not provided
    region = None
```
lee_backend: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/512 (adds trimming check)
sam_sre: Rolling forward header-strip rollback now. Monitoring latency and billing flags.
maria_support: ACME — can you confirm if latency improves after strip rule?
acme_john: After ~2min looks better :thumbsup: latency down to 45ms from 420ms. Billing still needs adjustment for the misrouted window.
maria_support: I'll open billing ticket separately and loop in finance. For engineering follow-up: please prioritize the router fix in next hotfix release.
sam_sre: Agreed. Assigning to p1. I'll run additional sweeps to detect other empty-header insertions.
lee_backend: Note: also found one path where query param parser accepted `region=` (empty) and treated as value present. I'll update to same trim/absent semantics.
maria_support: Closing loop with ACME: we'll notify when fix is rolled and when billing credit is available. Thanks team. :heart:
acme_john: Thanks all — appreciate the quick action.
